name: Uiverse
license_notes: Community contributions are submitted under MIT or CC0. Unrestricted use in personal and commercial web applications. Check individual submissions for external font/asset dependencies.
description: Massive community-driven open-source library of micro-UI elements built in pure HTML/CSS and Tailwind. Great for animated buttons, complex loaders, and interactive form controls.

name: FreeFrontend
license_notes: Snippets are sourced from open-source CodePens and GitHub. Public CodePens are automatically licensed under MIT by CodePen terms of service. Free for commercial projects; keeping original author comments in code is recommended.
description: Hand-curated collection of free frontend code snippets organized by UI element. Ideal for finding CSS pagination bars, hover-effect menus, and creative animation patterns.

name: CodeMyUI
license_notes: Aggregates web design inspiration, micro-interactions, and UI animations from open CodePens. CodePen public pens default to MIT. Completely free to adapt into commercial software.
description: Curated showcase of web design inspiration and functional front-end snippets. Specializes in micro-interactions, unique pagination animations, and CSS transitions.

name: shadcn/ui
license_notes: 100% free and open-source under MIT. The code is placed directly into your own codebase, giving you full ownership with zero commercial restrictions.
description: The modern industry standard for React web apps. Not an npm dependency, but a collection of beautifully designed, fully accessible components built with Radix UI and Tailwind CSS copied straight into your repository.

name: HyperUI
license_notes: 100% open-source under MIT. Free for personal and commercial use without attribution requirements in production binaries or sites.
description: Massive open-source directory of free Tailwind CSS components across application UI, marketing layouts, and e-commerce sections with multi-framework code tabs.

name: Flowbite (Core Open Source)
license_notes: The core Flowbite library (and official React/Vue/Svelte wrappers) is 100% MIT licensed and free for commercial applications. Caveat: Themesberg also sells commercial 'Flowbite Pro' blocks/templates under a separate paid license. Stick to the MIT core repository.
description: Extensive library of UI components built on Tailwind CSS with interactive vanilla JS plugins, official React/Vue/Svelte packages, and Figma tokens.

name: Mantine
license_notes: 100% free and open-source under MIT. Zero restrictions on commercial and enterprise use.
description: Feature-rich React component library with built-in dark theme, deep customization via CSS modules or CSS-in-JS, and an extensive suite of 50+ production utility hooks.

name: daisyUI
license_notes: 100% MIT license. Completely free for personal and commercial applications. Adds clean semantic classes to Tailwind without bloating HTML.
description: The most popular component library plugin for Tailwind CSS. Replaces repetitive utility class sprawl with semantic component class names (`btn`, `card`, `modal`) while preserving full Tailwind utility overrides.

name: Magic UI
license_notes: 100% open-source under MIT. Free for commercial and personal landing pages, SaaS apps, and marketing sites.
description: 50+ free, animated UI components crafted with React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion for high-conversion landing pages.

name: Tailblocks
license_notes: 100% MIT license. Copy-paste Tailwind section blocks ready for commercial sites.
description: Ready-to-use HTML and Tailwind CSS section blocks with built-in dark/light mode toggle and color theme switcher.

name: Float UI
license_notes: 100% free open-source MIT license. Commercial and private use allowed without restrictions.
description: Curated collection of clean Tailwind CSS components and website templates supporting multiple framework dialects (React, Vue, Svelte, HTML).

name: Pines UI
license_notes: 100% MIT license. The core component library is free for personal and commercial apps. DevDojo also offers optional paid templates.
description: Lightweight UI component library for Alpine.js and Tailwind CSS. Perfect for developers building server-rendered apps (Laravel, Rails, Django) who want interactive UI without heavy React bundles.

name: Radix UI Primitives
license_notes: 100% MIT license. The foundational unstyled primitives powering shadcn/ui and many enterprise design systems.
description: Unstyled, accessible React components with full WAI-ARIA compliance, keyboard navigation, focus management, and screen-reader support.

name: Headless UI
license_notes: Created and maintained by Tailwind Labs under 100% MIT license. Completely unstyled, providing seamless Tailwind integration.
description: Completely unstyled, fully accessible UI components designed to integrate seamlessly with Tailwind CSS utility classes.

name: Ark UI
license_notes: 100% MIT license by Chakra Systems. Framework-agnostic headless UI library built on Zag.js finite state machines.
description: Modern headless component library powered by Zag.js state machines, providing identical accessibility logic across React, Vue, and Solid.

name: Shoelace / Web Awesome
license_notes: Shoelace open-source core is 100% MIT licensed. Framework-independent, works with React, Vue, Angular, or vanilla HTML.
description: A collection of professionally designed, highly customizable UI components built on Web Standards (Custom Elements & Shadow DOM). Works anywhere regardless of frontend framework.

name: Chakra UI
license_notes: 100% MIT license. Free for commercial enterprise software.
description: Simple, modular, and accessible component library that gives you the building blocks to build React applications with ergonomic style props.

name: Tremor
license_notes: 100% open-source under Apache 2.0. Free commercial usage with explicit patent protections.
description: Open-source React component library to build modern analytics and dashboard views using Tailwind CSS and Recharts primitives.
